logical_path_rule.classification: Explicit relative path containing '/', not a bare filename.

L2_rule.proof: A drive-qualified or slash-containing quoted path is returned unchanged. Only a bare filename is prefixed with its source file directory. No filesystem fallback or path search.

L1_rule.proof: l1_path_is_bare rejects '/' or '\\' and a drive prefix; l1_import_path_text only invokes the source-relative join for a bare path. The supplied explicit spelling is decoded and retained, not rebased to the copied frontend-source.lm1 directory.

actual_file_reader.proof: fopen(path,rb), read and parse that one path; failure returns1. No alternative root is searched.

source_text_reader.proof: Also reads the exact supplied path via fopen(rb); it does not search include roots.

The P0 route allocates and checks the target path, removes generated ledger entry64, calls decl_write(target,51), removes partial output and aborts on failure, then records its hash note.

child_CWD_source_chain.proof: bld_step_t passes its explicit cwd to os_run; frontend, machine-module and runtime callers supply src. It requires kind0/exit0 for success.
Windows converts that cwd and passes wcwd to CreateProcessW; conversion or process-creation failure is a failed step, not inherited-CWD fallback.
POSIX child chdir(cwd) failure reports an error and exits127 before exec.

L2_predef_metadata.proof: The collector retains normalized quoted paths via lm_compiler_predef_import; malformed input or inability to hold the path fails.
Predef readers remove quotes and pass the retained exact path to snap_document; nested predefs use the same resolver.
Snapshot reader opens that exact path in rb; missing/read/allocation failure returns0, not a different file.
Snapshot/cache is keyed by the exact path spelling. Parsed documents are retained for that operation; this does not create an alternate provider or root search.
A .h.lm1 predef belongs in the generated machine header; an ordinary .lm1 predef such as libc_abi is emitted in the module's own predefs, with the retained spelling.
L2 publication checks snapshot files against their initial bytes; mismatch/cannot-read removes the temporary output and fails.

error_and_evidence_boundaries: Writer path/allocation/directory/open/fputs/fclose failure aborts each inspected normal route before consumers; partial generated output is removed on write failure.
L1 quoted-path/allocation failure, import cycle, file-read/parse failure, empty or invalid unit, or output failure returns failure; no secondary file search was found in the inspected resolver.
An invocation with the wrong cwd can select a different file with the same explicit relative spelling. This is not a resolver fallback; it is why actual child-CWD binding matters.
